name: web-search
description: Real-time web search and article extraction through AnySearch or Tavily.
description_cn: 通过 AnySearch 或 Tavily 提供实时网页搜索和正文提取。

config_fields.name: SEARCH_PROVIDER
config_fields.label: 默认搜索服务
config_fields.help: AI 可在单次调用中显式覆盖；服务失败时不会自动切换。

config_fields.name: ANYSEARCH_API_KEY
config_fields.label: AnySearch API Key
config_fields.help: 选填；未配置时使用限额更低的匿名访问。

config_fields.name: TAVILY_API_KEY
config_fields.label: Tavily API Key
config_fields.help: 选填；未配置时使用限额更低的 Keyless 模式。

workflow: Use the configured provider unless the call explicitly selects another provider.
Never switch providers automatically after a failure.
Obtain explicit user consent before registering an AnySearch account and saving its API key.
